I take AI projects through the full development cycle — from research and experimentation to model development, benchmarking, evaluation, and production-ready systems.

projects.title: Crop Detection
projects.blurb: End-to-end pipeline for early-stage detection of field crops like sugar beet and cotton from drone imagery.
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end computer vision pipeline for early-stage crop detection and stand counting in large-scale, high-resolution drone imagery of sugar beet and cotton fields.
bullets: Owned the full development process — from data analysis and processing, annotation handling, and model development to integration into the company's production system
Built the crop detection module using YOLO-NAS, and integrated row detection to improve counting accuracy and suppress detections between crop rows
Developed automated processing for converting point annotations into bounding boxes and preparing training data
Evaluated and optimized the system using Precision–Recall analysis and detection threshold tuning

projects.title: Crop-Type Semantic Segmentation
projects.blurb: Semantic segmentation model for crop-type classification using satellite SAR (radar) imagery.
description: Developed a deep learning–based semantic segmentation system for crop-type classification using satellite SAR (radar) imagery, enabling crop mapping without relying on optical imagery.
The system uses temporal Sentinel-1 radar data (VV/VH) to distinguish crop types such as corn and soybean, with a U-Net / ConvLSTM architecture for spatial and temporal modeling.
The project included the full AI pipeline — from satellite data preparation and handling missing observations to model development, training, evaluation, and optimization.
